title: Function template: max_of
prompt: Implement `template <typename T> const T& max_of(const T& a, const T& b)` returning a const reference to the larger element (ties: return either — `b` is fine). It must instantiate for int, double, and std::string alike.

tests.name: ints
tests.hint: Deduction picks T = int from the arguments.

tests.name: doubles
tests.hint: T = double works without spelling it.

tests.name: strings
tests.hint: std::string has operator<, lexicographic — the contract holds.
